This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
```

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |

## Build & Run

```bash
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. - `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start

- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context

- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

122	### 4.2 effectively_greedy 判定
123	
124	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
125	
126	`is_greedy` 回答「参数显式要求贪心吗」，但还有一类行：参数名义上要采样（温度正常、`top_k != 1`），可它的 `top_p` 小到核里只剩一个 token——**语义上**它就是贪心。`effectively_greedy` 是把这类「隐式贪心」也识别出来、统一改道 argmax 的谓词。
127	
128	为什么必须改道，而不是让它照常走采样器？两个原因（都写在 `select_batch` 的文档注释里，[src/lib.rs:L171-L177](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L171-L177)）：
129	
130	1. **确定性**：当最大概率处存在 bf16 并列时，拒绝采样器会在并列成员里按随机数挑一个——同一个请求换个引擎种子就换输出。argmax 则按下标最低破并列，永远确定。
131	2. **省一次 softmax**：核内只有一个 token 时，采样通道的 softmax / 归一化全是白做的工作。
132	
133	这个谓词是 `pub` 的，且文档写明理由：自带贪心路径的模型（如 Kimi-K2，见 u1-l1）必须复刻 `select_batch` 的这条语义，否则同样的参数在两条路径下行为分叉（[src/lib.rs:L448-L454](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L448-L454)）。
134	
135	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
136	
137	```text
138	effectively_greedy(params, vocab_size) =
139	    params.is_greedy()                          # 第一级：显式贪心
140	    或 (
141	        vocab_size > 0                           # 防守：宽度为 0 时 1/0 = +inf，见下
142	        且 params.top_p.is_finite()              # 防守：NaN / inf 不判定
143	        且 params.top_p > 0.0                    # 防守：恰为 0 是退化值，不判定
144	        且 params.top_p <= 1.0 / vocab_size      # 核坍缩判据（4.3 节推导）
145	    )
146	```
147	
148	它在 `select_batch` 中的使用位置——注意宽度传的是 `scratch.selection_width`：
149	
150	```text
151	select_batch:
152	    校验批大小 / 步数 / arena 行数 / vocab 宽度
153	    is_argmax = |p| effectively_greedy(p, scratch.selection_width)
154	    greedy 行号集合   = filter_map(is_argmax)          → 一次批式 indexed argmax
155	    sampling 行号集合 = filter(非 is_argmax 且无 seed)   → 一次 FlashInfer 批式采样
156	    seeded 行         = 逐行（若 is_argmax 则同样跳过采样）
157	```
158	
159	一个容易被忽略的细节：`effectively_greedy` 为真的行在**三条**路径上都被改道——贪心集合收入它（[src/lib.rs:L229-L233](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L229-L233)），无种子采样集合排除它（[src/lib.rs:L268-L271](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L268-L271)），带种子的单行循环也跳过它（[src/lib.rs:L300-L302](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L300-L302)）——对 argmax 谈种子没有意义。
160	
161	三个防守条件的用意：
162	
163	- `vocab_size > 0`：Rust 里 `1.0f32 / 0.0f32` 不 panic，结果是 `+inf`。若不防守，任何有限 `top_p` 都满足 `top_p <= inf`，一个荒谬的零宽词表会让**所有**行被判定为贪心。
164	- `top_p.is_finite()`：NaN 与任何数比较都是 `false`，本条会自然失败，但显式写出让意图可读；`+inf` 同理被排除。
165	- `top_p > 0.0`：`top_p = 0`（核为空集的退化值）不被认领，保守地下放给采样通道去处理或报错。整个谓词的设计取向是：**只在核坍缩论证无懈可击时才认领**，其余一律交给采样器。

223	### 4.3 top_p 核数学与 bf16 并列
224	
225	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
226	
227	本节推导 `effectively_greedy` 的数学核心，然后解释它的「敌人」——bf16 并列最大值——为什么会让采样器失去确定性。
228	
229	**核坍缩论证**：top-p 的核是「按概率降序排列后，累计概率达到 `top_p` 的最小前缀」。只要 `top_p <= 1/V`，核就至多含一个 token。这不是经验观察，是可以证明的定理，而两个回归测试就是这条定理的冻结形式（测试文件头部的注释说明了分工：裸核正确性归 `pegainfer-kernels`，本 crate 测试钉的是策略行为）。
230	
231	**bf16 并列问题**：推理引擎的设备端 logits 是 bf16。bf16 尾数只有 7 位，两个「概念上不同」的 logits 很容易舍入到同一个 bf16 值——概率完全并列。此时：
232	
233	- argmax 核按下标最低破并列：永远返回同一个 token。
234	- 拒绝采样器面对并列（或核边界上的等概率对）时，抽到哪个取决于随机数——而引擎种子每个解码步都在换（u2-l4），于是「top_p 极小」的请求每次跑、每步都可能在并列成员之间跳。
235	
236	测试注释（[tests/select_batch.rs:L144-L152](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L144-L152)）还记录了历史：旧的每请求 RNG 恰好**掩盖**了这个不确定性（同请求同种子，跳了也看不出来）；迁移到每步 philox 种子后问题暴露，这条路由与回归测试随之诞生。
237	
238	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
239	
240	**定理**：对任意 logits 列 \( x_1, \dots, x_V \)（\( V \ge 1 \)），softmax 最大概率满足
241	
242	\[
243	p_{\max} \;=\; \frac{e^{x_{\max}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{V} e^{x_j}}
244	\;\ge\; \frac{e^{x_{\max}}}{V \cdot e^{x_{\max}}}
245	\;=\; \frac{1}{V}
246	\]
247	
248	第二步用了 \( e^{x_j} \le e^{x_{\max}} \) 对所有 \( j \) 成立，故分母 \( \le V e^{x_{\max}} \)。等号当且仅当分布均匀（所有 logit 相同）时取得。
249	
250	**推论**：若 \( \text{top\_p} \le \dfrac{1}{V} \le p_{\max} \)，则排序后第一个 token 的累计概率已达到 `top_p`，核恰为 { argmax }（及其并列同伴，见下），从核中采样不再有随机性可言——除非核里混进了并列同伴，而那正是 argmax 破并列规则要接管的原因。
251	
252	**均匀分布的边界情形**（综合实践会手算）：\( V = 8 \)、所有 logit 相等时 \( p_i = 1/8 \)，\( p_{\max} = 1/8 \) 恰好压线。取 `top_p = 1/8`：第一个 token 累计概率 \( 1/8 \ge 1/8 \) 达标，核为单 token。这就是 `effectively_greedy` 用 `<=`（含等号）的原因——等号处核仍是单 token。
253	
254	**bf16 并列时序**（对照 `tiny_top_p` 测试的场景）：

258	        1/V ≈ 6.58e-6 < p_max ≈ 0.019

260	top_p = 1e-6 ≤ 1/V：
261	    若走采样器：并列对进入核边界 → 拒绝采样按随机数挑 → 不同引擎种子可能给出 879 或 6941
262	    改道 argmax：按下标最低破并列 → 永远 879，与贪心逐种子一致   ← 测试断言的行为
263	```

291	   - 令 `top_p = 1/8`：按降序累计，第一个 token 累计 \( 1/8 \ge 1/8 \) 即达标，核 = 单 token。再令 `top_p = 1/8 + 10^{-6}`：第一个 token 累计 \( 1/8 < \text{top\_p} \)，核必须再纳入 token——两个候选（均匀分布下任意两个都等价）都满足，核不再单元素。这就是「恰等于」与「略大于」的分界。
292	   - 把定理的一般形式写一遍：任取一列 logits，用 \( \sum_j e^{x_j} \le V e^{x_{\max}} \) 推出 \( p_{\max} \ge 1/V \)，并注明等号条件（均匀分布）。
293	   - 读 [tests/select_batch.rs:L199-L209](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L199-L209) 的对照组，回答：为什么这个测试不仅断言「结果 ∈ {lo, hi}」，还**必须**断言 `sampled_the_peer` 在某种子下为真？
294	3. **需要观察的现象**：纸笔推导中「略大于」情形核大小跳变；对照组断言里 `assert!(sampled_the_peer, ...)` 是硬性要求。
295	4. **预期结果**：推导成立；对照组若 64 个种子全返回 `lo`，`assert!` 会失败并报「control: an arena-width routing decision puts this row on the sampler」——即测试要求随机性**必须发生**，从而证明路由判据一旦算错宽，行为立刻退化为随机。该测试本身需要 GPU，待本地验证。
296	
297	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
298	
299	**练习 1**：`vocab = 151_936` 时，`1/vocab` 约是多少？`tiny_top_p` 测试为什么选 `1e-6`？
300	
301	**答案**：\( 1/151936 \approx 6.58 \times 10^{-6} \)。`1e-6 < 6.58e-6`，满足 `top_p <= 1/vocab`，核坍缩为单 token，行必须走 argmax。若选 `top_p` 在 \( 6.6 \times 10^{-6} \) 与 \( p_{\max} \approx 0.019 \) 之间（比如 `1e-4`），核可能仍很小但**论证不再成立**，谓词正确地不认领它。
302	
303	**练习 2**：两个测试都把并列设在 `8.0` 对 `8.0`，为什么强调「bf16-exact」？换成 `8.01` 对 `8.0` 会怎样？
304	
305	**答案**：8.0 的 bf16 表示精确无舍入误差，两行读进设备 arena 后是**真正相等**的 logits，构成真并列。换成 8.01：bf16 在 8.0 附近的间距是 \( 2^3 \times 2^{-7} = 0.0625 \)，8.01 与 8.0 相差 0.01 < 0.0625，两者会舍入到**同一个** bf16 值——还是并列（这恰好说明 bf16 并列多常见）；但如果差值超过 0.0625，就不并列了，argmax 永远选大的，测试就失去了「并列」这个考点。
306	
307	**练习 3**：`padded_arena_width` 测试里，为什么对照组用 `SampleScratch::new(&ctx, 512, 1)` 而实验组必须用 `with_selection_width(&ctx, 512, 256, 1)`？两个调用各自的 selection width 是多少？
308	
309	**答案**：`SampleScratch::new` 把 selection width 默认成 vocab（见 [src/lib.rs:L93-L95](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L93-L95)），对照组因此以 512 为判据：`1/256 > 1/512`，行走采样器（对照所欲）。实验组显式传 256：`1/256 <= 1/256`，行回 argmax。两组唯一差异是宽度，排除了其它解释——这是典型的控制变量测试结构。
310	
311	## 5. 综合实践
312	
313	**任务**：把 4.2 与 4.3 的边界分析合并成一份「表驱动」CPU 单元测试，为 `effectively_greedy` 覆盖规格要求的五种情形；外加完成 vocab=8 的纸笔验证（4.3.4 已铺垫）。

315	1. **实践目标**：一个不依赖 GPU 的测试，把 `effectively_greedy` 的两级判定与全部边界一次性钉死。
316	2. **操作步骤**：
317	   - 先完成 4.3.4 的纸笔推导（`top_p` 恰等于 / 略大于 `1/vocab` 的核大小跳变）。
318	   - 在自己克隆的仓库中，向 `src/lib.rs` 的 `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`（[src/lib.rs:L651-L704](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L651-L704)）添加以下测试。**示例代码**（非项目原有代码）：
319	
320	   ```rust
321	   use super::{SamplingParams, effectively_greedy};
322	
323	   /// 表驱动：五种情形一次钉死。non_greedy_base 排除 is_greedy 的两条判据，
324	   /// 使每行只考验 top_p 分支。
325	   #[test]
326	   fn effectively_greedy_table() {
327	       let non_greedy_base = SamplingParams {
328	           temperature: 1.0,
329	           top_k: -1,
330	           ..SamplingParams::default()
331	       };
332	       let with_top_p = |top_p: f32| SamplingParams {
333	           top_p,
334	           ..non_greedy_base
335	       };
336	
337	       // 情形 1：显式贪心（temperature=0 命中 is_greedy；top_k=1 同理）
338	       assert!(effectively_greedy(&SamplingParams::default(), 8));
339	       let topk1 = SamplingParams {
340	           temperature: 1.0,
341	           top_k: 1,
342	           ..SamplingParams::default()
343	       };
344	       assert!(effectively_greedy(&topk1, 8));
345	
346	       // 情形 2：top_p 恰等于 1/vocab —— 均匀分布边界，核仍单 token
347	       assert!(effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(1.0 / 8.0), 8));
348	
349	       // 情形 3：top_p 略大于 1/vocab —— 核纳入第二个 token，语义上不是贪心
350	       assert!(!effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(1.0 / 8.0 + 1e-6), 8));
351	
352	       // 情形 4：退化 top_p（0 与 NaN）不认领，保守下放采样通道
353	       assert!(!effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(0.0), 8));
354	       assert!(!effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(f32::NAN), 8));
355	
356	       // 情形 5：selection_width 小于 vocab —— 同一 top_p=1/256，
357	       //        以 256 为宽是贪心（恰压线），以 512 为宽不是（padded 场景）
358	       assert!(effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(1.0 / 256.0), 256));
359	       assert!(!effectively_greedy(&with_top_p(1.0 / 256.0), 512));
360	   }
361	   ```
362	
363	   - 运行：`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sample --lib effectively_greedy -- --nocapture`。
364	3. **需要观察的现象**：五个情形、八个断言全部通过；特别留意情形 2 与情形 3 之间只差 `1e-6`，判定却翻转——这就是核坍缩的边界。情形 5 的两个断言用同一个 `top_p` 值证明判定随宽度翻转（#1046 的教训浓缩成两行）。
365	4. **预期结果**：测试通过（`effectively_greedy` 是纯函数，无需 GPU；编译仍需 CUDA 工具链，因为 `pegainfer-kernels` 的 build.rs 编译 `.cu` 源）。待本地验证。

367	
368	## 6. 本讲小结
369	
370	- `SamplingParams` 是前端契约（`pegainfer-frontend`），本 crate 再导出；默认参数（`temperature = 0.0`）即贪心。
371	- 两级判定：`is_greedy`（显式：`temperature < 1e-5` 或 `top_k == 1`，契约层、不知词表宽度）→ `effectively_greedy`（策略层：追加 `0 < top_p <= 1/selection_width` 的核坍缩判据）。
372	- 数学核心：\( p_{\max} \ge 1/V \) 恒成立（因 \( \sum e^{x_j} \le V e^{x_{\max}} \)），故 `top_p <= 1/V` 时核只剩 argmax 一个 token；等号在均匀分布处压线仍单 token。

# SamplingParams 与 effectively_greedy：一行走不走 argmax 由什么决定

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

- 读懂 `SamplingParams` 每个字段（`temperature` / `top_k` / `top_p` / `min_p` / `seed`）的语义，以及「显式贪心」`is_greedy()` 的两条判据。
- 推导 `effectively_greedy` 背后的数学：softmax 的最大概率恒 >= \( 1/V \)，因此 `top_p <= 1/V` 时核（nucleus）只剩 argmax 那一个 token。
- 解释为什么 bf16 并列最大值（tie）会让拒绝采样器变得不确定，而 argmax 路径（按下标最低破并列）是确定的。
- 区分两级判定：`is_greedy`（参数显式要求贪心）与 `effectively_greedy`（参数名义上要采样，但语义等价于贪心）。
- 理解路由宽度为什么是 `scratch.selection_width`（可发射词表）而不是 logits arena 的物理宽度（tile 对齐填充列）。

本讲是单元二「select_batch 批式选 token 主链路」的第一讲：路由谓词是整条主链路的第一个决策点，后续的 scratch 布局（u2-l2）与三路分发（u2-l3）都建立在它之上。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲只需要一点概率与浮点数的常识，不需要 GPU 编程经验。

- **logits 与 softmax**：语言模型为词表中的每个 token 输出一个实数分数（logit）。softmax 把一列 logits 变成一列概率：\( p_i = \dfrac{e^{x_i}}{\sum_j e^{x_j}} \)，所有 \( p_i \) 之和为 1。logit 越大，概率越高。
- **贪心解码（greedy / argmax）**：永远选概率最大的 token，即 argmax。它完全确定——同样的输入永远得到同样的输出。`temperature = 0` 的直觉含义就是「退化成 argmax」。
- **温度（temperature）**：采样前把 logits 除以 \( t \)。\( t > 1 \) 拉平分布（更随机），\( t \to 0 \) 则分布尖成一根针（极限即 argmax）。
- **top-k**：只保留概率最高的 k 个 token，其余置零后再归一化。`top_k = 1` 等价于只留一个 token，也就是等价于贪心。
- **top-p / 核采样（nucleus sampling）**：把 token 按概率从高到低排序，取**累计概率恰好达到 `top_p` 的最小前缀**作为候选集（核），再在核内按（归一化后的）概率随机抽一个。`top_p = 1` 表示不裁剪。
- **min_p**：以最大概率为基准的阈值过滤——概率低于 \( \text{min\_p} \times p_{\max} \) 的 token 被屏蔽。默认 `0.0` 表示关闭。
- **bf16（bfloat16）**：一种 16 位浮点格式，指数位与 f32 相同（8 位），但尾数只有 7 位。数值间距粗——例如在 8.0 附近，两个相差不到 0.0625 的 f32 logit 会被舍入成**同一个** bf16 值。也就是说，模型里「并列第一」比直觉中常见得多。
- **确定性（determinism）**：对一个推理引擎，「temperature = 0 的请求每次输出都一样」是用户默认的契约。凡是让 token 依赖随机数流的做法都会破坏它。

本 crate 的背景（u1-l1 已建立）：`pegainfer-sample` 是所有模型 crate 共享的采样策略层，`select_batch` 把一个 logits arena 变成「每行一个 token id」，没有任何逐行逃生舱。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 | 本讲关注点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs` | crate 全部实现（单文件） | `effectively_greedy` 谓词、`select_batch` 里调用它的路由点、`SampleScratch::with_selection_width` 的宽度语义 |
| `pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs` | 需要 GPU 的模型无关集成测试 | `tiny_top_p_routes_to_argmax_even_under_bf16_ties` 与 `padded_arena_width_does_not_suppress_the_argmax_routing` 两个回归测试——本讲数学论证的「冻结形式」 |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs` | 契约 crate（crate 外，一个文件） | `SamplingParams` 结构体定义、默认值、`is_greedy()` 判定 |

`SamplingParams` 不住在采样 crate 里——它是前端契约的一部分，`pegainfer-sample` 通过 `pub use` 再导出（见 [src/lib.rs:L33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L33)），模型 crate 因此不必直接依赖前端 crate 就能构造参数。这是 u1-l1 讲过的分层：策略归本 crate，契约归前端。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 SamplingParams 契约字段

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

一行（一个请求）怎么采样，完全由它的 `SamplingParams` 描述。这个结构体是「用户意图」的载体：温度多高、裁剪多狠、要不要固定种子。路由的第一级判定 `is_greedy()` 就建立在这些字段上——参数**显式**说「我要贪心」时，无需任何数学论证，直接走 argmax。

关键是要把「用户写字段」和「字段合起来的语义」分开看：`temperature = 0` 与 `top_k = 1` 是两种完全不同的写法，但语义相同（都只剩一个可发射 token）。`is_greedy()` 就是把这两种写法归一成同一个判定的函数。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`SamplingParams` 的字段与默认值：

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 语义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `temperature` | `f32` | `0.0` | 采样温度；`< 1e-5` 视为贪心 |
| `top_k` | `i32` | `-1` | 只保留前 k 个 token；`-1` 关闭；`1` 等价贪心 |
| `top_p` | `f32` | `1.0` | 核采样阈值；`1.0` 不裁剪；本讲的主角 |
| `min_p` | `f32` | `0.0` | 相对最大概率的阈值过滤；`0.0` 关闭，有效范围 `[0, 1)` |
| `seed` | `Option<u64>` | `None` | 每请求种子；`Some` 时该行做单行可重放调用（u2-l4 的主题） |
| `ignore_eos` | `bool` | `false` | 是否忽略结束符（本讲不涉及） |

`is_greedy()` 的判定流程（伪代码）：

```text
is_greedy(p) =
    p.temperature < 1e-5        # 温度趋零的极限就是 argmax
    或 p.top_k == 1             # 掩码后只剩一个幸存 token
```

注意默认参数（`temperature = 0.0`）本身就满足第一条——所以「不配置任何采样参数」的请求默认是贪心的。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

契约结构体定义在 `pegainfer-frontend`（crate 外），字段与文档注释一目了然：

- [pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs:L1-L16](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs#L1-L16) — `SamplingParams` 结构体：五个采样字段加 `ignore_eos`。`min_p` 的注释给出精确定义「概率低于 `min_p * p_max` 的 token 被屏蔽」；`seed` 的注释明确种子能重放什么 是引擎的承诺，不是采样器的）。
- [pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs:L18-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs#L18-L29) — `Default` 实现：`temperature: 0.0`、`top_k: -1`、`top_p: 1.0`、`min_p: 0.0`、`seed: None`。默认即贪心。
- [pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs:L31-L40](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs#L31-L40) — `is_greedy()`：`self.temperature < 1e-5 || self.top_k == 1`。文档注释解释了两点：温度趋零的极限是 argmax 且 `1/temperature` 在那之前早就溢出（核内是乘 `1/t` 的，epsilon 线避开溢出）；vLLM 也在 `1e-5` 处画同一条线。

再导出与路由入口（本 crate 内）：

- [src/lib.rs:L33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L33) — `pub use pegainfer_frontend::sampler::SamplingParams;`：模型 crate 从本 crate 拿到契约类型，分层单向。
- [src/lib.rs:L171-L177](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L171-L177) — `select_batch` 文档中关于路由的一段：一行在 `effectively_greedy` 成立时走 argmax 路径——显式贪心参数，**或** `top_p <= 1/vocab` 紧到只有 argmax 幸存的核。并说明这样做的两个收益：确定性与跳过一次不必要的 softmax。

### 4.2 effectively_greedy 判定

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`is_greedy` 回答「参数显式要求贪心吗」，但还有一类行：参数名义上要采样（温度正常、`top_k != 1`），可它的 `top_p` 小到核里只剩一个 token——**语义上**它就是贪心。`effectively_greedy` 是把这类「隐式贪心」也识别出来、统一改道 argmax 的谓词。

为什么必须改道，而不是让它照常走采样器？两个原因（都写在 `select_batch` 的文档注释里，[src/lib.rs:L171-L177](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L171-L177)）：

1. **确定性**：当最大概率处存在 bf16 并列时，拒绝采样器会在并列成员里按随机数挑一个——同一个请求换个引擎种子就换输出。argmax 则按下标最低破并列，永远确定。
2. **省一次 softmax**：核内只有一个 token 时，采样通道的 softmax / 归一化全是白做的工作。

这个谓词是 `pub` 的，且文档写明理由：自带贪心路径的模型（如 Kimi-K2，见 u1-l1）必须复刻 `select_batch` 的这条语义，否则同样的参数在两条路径下行为分叉（[src/lib.rs:L448-L454](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L448-L454)）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
effectively_greedy(params, vocab_size) =
    params.is_greedy()                          # 第一级：显式贪心
    或 (
        vocab_size > 0                           # 防守：宽度为 0 时 1/0 = +inf，见下
        且 params.top_p.is_finite()              # 防守：NaN / inf 不判定
        且 params.top_p > 0.0                    # 防守：恰为 0 是退化值，不判定
        且 params.top_p <= 1.0 / vocab_size      # 核坍缩判据（4.3 节推导）
    )
```

它在 `select_batch` 中的使用位置——注意宽度传的是 `scratch.selection_width`：

```text
select_batch:
    校验批大小 / 步数 / arena 行数 / vocab 宽度
    is_argmax = |p| effectively_greedy(p, scratch.selection_width)
    greedy 行号集合   = filter_map(is_argmax)          → 一次批式 indexed argmax
    sampling 行号集合 = filter(非 is_argmax 且无 seed)   → 一次 FlashInfer 批式采样
    seeded 行         = 逐行（若 is_argmax 则同样跳过采样）
```

一个容易被忽略的细节：`effectively_greedy` 为真的行在**三条**路径上都被改道——贪心集合收入它（[src/lib.rs:L229-L233](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L229-L233)），无种子采样集合排除它（[src/lib.rs:L268-L271](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L268-L271)），带种子的单行循环也跳过它（[src/lib.rs:L300-L302](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/src/lib.rs#L300-L302)）——对 argmax 谈种子没有意义。

三个防守条件的用意：

- `vocab_size > 0`：Rust 里 `1.0f32 / 0.0f32` 不 panic，结果是 `+inf`。若不防守，任何有限 `top_p` 都满足 `top_p <= inf`，一个荒谬的零宽词表会让**所有**行被判定为贪心。
- `top_p.is_finite()`：NaN 与任何数比较都是 `false`，本条会自然失败，但显式写出让意图可读；`+inf` 同理被排除。
- `top_p > 0.0`：`top_p = 0`（核为空集的退化值）不被认领，保守地下放给采样通道去处理或报错。整个谓词的设计取向是：**只在核坍缩论证无懈可击时才认领**，其余一律交给采样器。

### 4.3 top_p 核数学与 bf16 并列

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

本节推导 `effectively_greedy` 的数学核心，然后解释它的「敌人」——bf16 并列最大值——为什么会让采样器失去确定性。

**核坍缩论证**：top-p 的核是「按概率降序排列后，累计概率达到 `top_p` 的最小前缀」。只要 `top_p <= 1/V`，核就至多含一个 token。这不是经验观察，是可以证明的定理，而两个回归测试就是这条定理的冻结形式（测试文件头部的注释说明了分工：裸核正确性归 `pegainfer-kernels`，本 crate 测试钉的是策略行为）。

**bf16 并列问题**：推理引擎的设备端 logits 是 bf16。bf16 尾数只有 7 位，两个「概念上不同」的 logits 很容易舍入到同一个 bf16 值——概率完全并列。此时：

- argmax 核按下标最低破并列：永远返回同一个 token。
- 拒绝采样器面对并列（或核边界上的等概率对）时，抽到哪个取决于随机数——而引擎种子每个解码步都在换（u2-l4），于是「top_p 极小」的请求每次跑、每步都可能在并列成员之间跳。

测试注释（[tests/select_batch.rs:L144-L152](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L144-L152)）还记录了历史：旧的每请求 RNG 恰好**掩盖**了这个不确定性（同请求同种子，跳了也看不出来）；迁移到每步 philox 种子后问题暴露，这条路由与回归测试随之诞生。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

**定理**：对任意 logits 列 \( x_1, \dots, x_V \)（\( V \ge 1 \)），softmax 最大概率满足

\[
p_{\max} \;=\; \frac{e^{x_{\max}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{V} e^{x_j}}
\;\ge\; \frac{e^{x_{\max}}}{V \cdot e^{x_{\max}}}
\;=\; \frac{1}{V}
\]

第二步用了 \( e^{x_j} \le e^{x_{\max}} \) 对所有 \( j \) 成立，故分母 \( \le V e^{x_{\max}} \)。等号当且仅当分布均匀（所有 logit 相同）时取得。

**推论**：若 \( \text{top\_p} \le \dfrac{1}{V} \le p_{\max} \)，则排序后第一个 token 的累计概率已达到 `top_p`，核恰为 { argmax }（及其并列同伴，见下），从核中采样不再有随机性可言——除非核里混进了并列同伴，而那正是 argmax 破并列规则要接管的原因。

**均匀分布的边界情形**（综合实践会手算）：\( V = 8 \)、所有 logit 相等时 \( p_i = 1/8 \)，\( p_{\max} = 1/8 \) 恰好压线。取 `top_p = 1/8`：第一个 token 累计概率 \( 1/8 \ge 1/8 \) 达标，核为单 token。这就是 `effectively_greedy` 用 `<=`（含等号）的原因——等号处核仍是单 token。

**bf16 并列时序**（对照 `tiny_top_p` 测试的场景）：

```text
logits: row[879] = 8.0, row[6941] = 8.0（bf16 下完全相等），其余 0.0，V = 151936
        1/V ≈ 6.58e-6 < p_max ≈ 0.019

top_p = 1e-6 ≤ 1/V：
    若走采样器：并列对进入核边界 → 拒绝采样按随机数挑 → 不同引擎种子可能给出 879 或 6941
    改道 argmax：按下标最低破并列 → 永远 879，与贪心逐种子一致   ← 测试断言的行为
```

   ```rust
       let non_greedy_base = SamplingParams {
           temperature: 1.0,
           top_k: -1,
           ..SamplingParams::default()
       };
   ```

- `SamplingParams` 是前端契约（`pegainfer-frontend`），本 crate 再导出；默认参数（`temperature = 0.0`）即贪心。
- 两级判定：`is_greedy`（显式：`temperature < 1e-5` 或 `top_k == 1`，契约层、不知词表宽度）→ `effectively_greedy`（策略层：追加 `0 < top_p <= 1/selection_width` 的核坍缩判据）。
- 数学核心：\( p_{\max} \ge 1/V \) 恒成立（因 \( \sum e^{x_j} \le V e^{x_{\max}} \)），故 `top_p <= 1/V` 时核只剩 argmax 一个 token；等号在均匀分布处压线仍单 token。

- 谓词是保守的：零宽词表、`top_p` 为 0/NaN/inf 一律不认领，下放采样通道；它同时守护三条路径（贪心集合、无种子批式、带种子单行循环）。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **下一讲 u2-l2（SampleScratch）**：本讲的 `selection_width` 只是字段一角，下一讲逐缓冲区拆解 `SampleScratch` 的分配布局——`row_indices`、argmax partials、pinned 回读槽位，以及 `with_selection_width` 与 `SampleScratch::new` 的关系。
- **再下一讲 u2-l3（三路分发）**：看 `effectively_greedy` 判定的行号如何流入批式 indexed argmax / FlashInfer 批式采样 / seeded 单行三条通道。
- **源码延伸阅读**：`pegainfer-frontend/src/sampler.rs` 全文（约 40 行，本讲已覆盖全部内容）；以及 [tests/select_batch.rs:L325-L371](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sample/tests/select_batch.rs#L325-L371) 的 `seeded_rows_replay_independent_of_batch_position`——它展示「语义等价贪心」之外的另一类确定性契约（种子可重放），是 u2-l4 的开场材料。

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.
